name: Heidi Hadley
reason: Her work (Total Somatics, clinical somatic education) is mainly pain relief: both Shift courses (Fascia Healing, Mindful Somatics & Neuroplasticity) name chronic pain, anxiety and injuries, her site is titled 'Somatic Movement for Pain Relief' and the membership is closed, so no offering passes the health-claim rule and only a handful of body-mechanics videos would remain.
